 Cook Islands set for decisive FIFA Series showdown against Tahiti
 Thursday 12 November 2026 | Written by Supplied | Published in Football , Sports 
 Share 
 The locally based players departed Rarotonga earlier this week. CIFA MEDIA/26111104 
 Cook Islands national men’s team has arrived in Tahiti ahead of the final two matches of the FIFA Series - International Men’s Friendly Matches, with the squad carrying confidence and momentum following a historic result on home soil.
 The locally based players departed Rarotonga earlier this week.
 The opening two matches of the four-game international series against Tahiti was held in Rarotonga in September, with each nation claiming one victory.
 The highlight for the Cook Islands came in the second fixture, where the national side secured a memorable 3-2 win over Tahiti. The result not only levelled the series at one win apiece but also marked one of the team’s most significant international victories in recent years, giving players and supporters a performance that will be remembered for years to come.
 The squad has settled into camp and begun preparations for what is expected to be another pair of competitive encounters between the Pacific neighbours.
 The third match of the series will kick off on Friday, 13 November at 6pm, while the fourth and final match will be played on Monday, 16 November at 6pm. Both fixtures will be held at the Tahiti Football Federation in Papeete.
 With the series evenly poised and pride on the line, the Cook Islands will be looking to build on the confidence gained from their recent victory and finish their Tahiti campaign strongly. The matches also provide another valuable opportunity for players to gain international experience and continue the development of the national programme against quality opposition.
 Cook Islands Football Association wishes the team and coaching staff all the best as they represent the nation in Tahiti and compete in the final chapter of an exciting FIFA Series. Supporters back home are encouraged to follow the team’s journey as they aim to conclude the series on a high.
